description:
List the authenticated user's OWN bots eligible for a personal fund roster.

    Personal funds can NEVER contain another user's bots — this returns only
    the caller's own personal + incubating + live bots with live engine stats
    and gamified card ratings.

    Args:
        domain: Filter by domain (e.g. "eth_usdc").

    Returns a JSON array of the user's bots.
name: list_my_bots
